## What is new

- Template string literals, with the prefix `t` (PEP 750).
- The evaluation of annotations is deferred (PEP 649 and PEP 749).
- The free-threaded build is supported (PEP 779).

## Removed and deprecated

The release removes some old modules and functions. The list is in the source.
